name: team-knowledge
description: Cross-project flow of team-level knowledge. Two scope-independent stages — a pull that imports OKF v0.2 cards from a shared team knowledge git repository (Practice cards go through the framework's own learnings persist ritual, never a hand-written memory edit) and a push that sediments affirmed team rules and confirmed domain knowledge back as one-card-one-file merge requests. Cards carry OKF trust signals (generated / verified / stale_after) plus a cde: extension for provenance, sanitization approval, and the memory destination; a single fail-closed validator runs both as the spoke's pre-push self-check and as the hub's MR gate.
